heading: INT. FLOATING MARKET - INSIDE THE GIANT'S RIBCAGE - DUSK

units.text: INT. FLOATING MARKET - INSIDE THE GIANT'S RIBCAGE - DUSK
Lantern-boats drift between enormous curved bones the color of old piano keys.
Stalls hang from them on ropes.
Fog moves along the waterway.
QUILL (30s, lean, ink-stained fingers, a satchel of maps) haggles at a stall hung with dried fish.
SABRA (20s, scarred cheek, hand always near a short knife) leans on a bone.
THORN (50s, barrel-chested, a pipe in his teeth) squats on the boat's stern and feeds a pair of ravens.
A HOODED WOMAN (age unknowable, gray cloak) sits by herself at the edge of the water, a single candle at her knee.
Eight silver for the lot.
units.name: QUILL

units.text: You said six.
units.name: SABRA

units.text: The price changed when the fog came in.
units.name: QUILL

units.text: The fog came in at noon.
units.name: THORN

units.text: It rises. It does not come in.
units.name: HOODED WOMAN

units.text: They all turn.
Sabra's hand tightens on the knife.
Who are you?
units.name: SABRA

units.text: Zephyrine.
units.name: HOODED WOMAN

units.text: Just Zephyrine?
units.name: QUILL

units.text: Just. It has been enough for six hundred years.
units.name: ZEPHYRINE

units.text: Quill. Sabra. We should go.
units.name: THORN

units.text: You have a map of the Ember Coast. I would very much like to see it.
units.name: ZEPHYRINE

units.text: Quill's hand goes to his satchel.
The ravens lift off the boat in a rush of black wings.
Thorn rises, pipe falling from his teeth.
A new shadow crosses the water.
GRIMBOLD (40s, stooped, wearing a toll-keeper's brass chain, his lantern held very high) steps onto the stall's plank and looks at them all with weary patience.
Toll.
units.name: GRIMBOLD

units.text: We paid at the gate.
units.name: SABRA

units.text: That was the gate. This is the rib.
units.name: GRIMBOLD

units.text: You can't charge for bones, you old thief.
units.name: THORN

units.text: ^You can't charge for a bone, it's the whole market.
units.name: QUILL

units.text: Bones belong to the dead. The dead pay me.
units.name: GRIMBOLD

units.text: Then let them pay for me, Grimbold. I am not here for the toll.
units.name: ZEPHYRINE

units.text: Grimbold's lantern wavers.
The candle at her knee gutters out.
For a long beat nobody speaks.
Then the old man bows, very slightly, and steps aside.
Mistress.
units.name: GRIMBOLD

units.text: The map.
units.name: ZEPHYRINE

units.text: Quill hands it over.
Sabra exhales.
Thorn retrieves his pipe from the planks and, with great care, does not relight it.
